heading.title: Of Grant of Probate and Letters of Administration

article.title: Persons to whom probate cannot be granted.
article.content:
223Persons to whom probate cannot be granted.

Section 223  ·  Part IX · Chapter I  ·  page 70 of the Act
Probate cannot be granted to any person who is a minor or is of unsound mind 2[nor to any association of individuals unless it is a company which satisfies the conditions prescribed by rules to be made 3[,by notification in the Official Gazette] by the 4[State Government] in this behalf].
2 Added by Act 17 of 1931, s. 2., The words “nor, unless the deceased was a Hindu, Muhammadan, Buddhist, Sikh or Jaina or an exempted person, to a married woman without the previous consent of her husband” which originally occurred at the end of this section had been omitted by Act 18 of 1927, s. 2.
3 Ins. by Act 20 of 1983, s. 2 and Sch. (w.e.f. 15-3-1984).
4 The words “G.G. in C.” have been successively amended by the A.O. 1937 and the A.O. 1950 to read as above.
